==Ingredients==

* 5 [[Cookbook:Pound|lbs]] [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* A touch of [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* [[Cookbook:Sage|Sage]]
* About 1 dozen [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaves]]
* Dried [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]] peels (optional)
* ½ lb [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]]
* [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]] (any kind is fine, but corn oil works best)
* [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Fat]]
* [[Cookbook:Flour|Flour]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]

==Procedure==
===Preparing the meat===
# [[Cookbook:Cube|Cube]] the meat. The more finely you cube the meat, the more deeply the spices will penetrate the mixture. However, it should not be ground.
# Mix the meat with salt, sugar, rosemary, sage, bay leaves, and orange peel.
# Begin to [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] the carrots.
# When the carrots are nearly done, [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] the meat, but be careful so that it does not brown. It needs only be just cooked.

===Preparing the sauce===

# Heat the fat in a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]]. When hot, add the flour, and stir constantly until a nice brown.
# Add the chopped onion, and continue to stir for a few minutes; then stir for about 5 minutes, or until the liquid is mostly evaporated.
# Add one third of the liquid, and stir until smooth and free from lumps.
# Add the rest of the liquid, and let boil slowly for 10 minutes; then [[Cookbook:Straining|strain]] and serve.

===Finishing it off===

#Add the meat and the carrots to the sauce. Add extra flavouring as necessary. Do not let the dish sit unrefrigerated for extended periods of time.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Note that not all the spices are necessary, but each adds to the dish's distinctive flavour.
